label: 侧跪坐前撑
pose_lead: Grounded pose, side-kneel with front support:
lower_limbs: One leg folds beneath the body while the other extends folded toward frame right, its knee on the ground.
upper_limbs: Both arms reach straight down, hands planted on the ground in front of the body.
torso_head: The upper body stays nearly upright with only a slight forward lean; the head turns a little to one side.
weight_silhouette: Hips and hands share the support for a stable stance; the legs open toward one side into a triangular silhouette.
